_doc: Exception deletion queue for allow-lists, bypasses, compatibility modes, temporary defaults, and architecture-lock carve-outs.
Every entry must have owner, expiryCondition, and deletionPrTarget. Missing metadata makes the exception P1 cleanup debt by default.

exceptions.expiryCondition: Payment issuance is refactored to persist and re-check a server-side readiness decision token instead of relying on upstream bind gating.
Checkout creation no longer writes policy lifecycle directly and delegates status transition to the canonical bind/payment command.
BO admin status override is replaced by explicit audited lifecycle commands with per-transition gates.
A product-adapter marginal-pricing API exists and recommendations no longer import motor leaf pricing directly.
Stored motor UW adjustment values are backfilled to the canonical array shape and document view models reject single-object adjustment payloads.
Cancellation rejection writes an explicit audited cancellation lifecycle command that is exempt from issuance transition matching without a file-level bypass.
BDX import validation obtains Motor product facts through product engines or adapter APIs instead of importing Motor internals.
Underwriting analysis obtains Motor facts through product engines or adapter APIs instead of importing Motor internals.
Motor public quote service delegates all pricing, UW, and wording internals through the product runtime engine boundary.
Seed data generation uses product runtime APIs or static fixtures and no longer imports Motor internals.
Claims surfaces consume policy communications, documents, and region APIs through public product exports or shared modules.
Program pricing and eligibility surfaces render entirely from product manifests without product string literals.
PolicyRecord no longer exposes Motor-shaped quoteData in shared BO model types.
Allowed modules either move their core dependencies behind module/domain contracts or the old backend/core business zones are deleted.
Platform startup validation and contract types no longer import app/domain layers, or the imports are replaced with generated/static contracts.
Historical BDX policies have binder-product authority rows backfilled or import path validates authority before write.
All deployed and local entrypoints provide tenant slug via JWT, header, host, or explicit CLI tenant config.
